verdict.rationale: E2B documents a code-interpreting use case where AI-generated code runs in its sandbox to analyze data (e2b-docs-33). You must bring and wire up your own LLM through tool use (e2b-docs-32), so the product supplies the execution layer rather than built-in insights or suggestions. missing for 10: built-in AI-generated insights/suggestions inside the product without an external LLM, in-depth docs on the analysis workflow and outputs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
